nl.title: JetBackup restore-scenario’s
nl.excerpt: JetBackup restore-scenario’s: bestanden, mailbox of database selectief terugzetten.
nl.bodyHtml:
Kies het kleinste restore-scope dat het probleem oplost — full account alleen als nodig.

Voorbereiding

  • Juiste backupdatum
  • Scope: files/mail/db

Stappen

  1. JetBackup → backups
  2. Kies datum
  3. Restore files voor themes/plugins of specifieke paden
  4. Of restore één mailbox/DB
  5. Valideer site

Controleren

  • Probleem weg
  • Geen onbedoelde dataverlies

Tip: Communiceer downtime/risico aan stakeholders bij full restore.

Let op: Restore overschrijft huidige staat van geselecteerde items.

Kom je er na deze stappen niet uit? Open een ticket bij TripleZero iT via het klantenpanel. Vermeld hostname, DirectAdmin-gebruikersnaam (geen wachtwoord), domein en wat je al probeerde.

Gerelateerd: jetbackup; backup-da.

en.title: JetBackup restore-scenario’s
en.excerpt: JetBackup restore-scenario’s: steps in security settings (panel, firewall or CMS) for jetbackup, restore, scenario.
en.bodyHtml:
For JetBackup restore-scenario’s follow a targeted checklist in security settings (panel, firewall or CMS). Core themes: jetbackup, restore, scenario.

Preparation

  • Access to security settings (panel, firewall or CMS)
  • Focus of this article: jetbackup, restore, scenario
  • Recent backup or snapshot

Steps

  1. Sign in to security settings (panel, firewall or CMS). Filter or search for parts that belong to jetbackup, restore, scenario.
  2. Map the risk around jetbackup (ports, accounts, plugins, logs).
  3. Apply the security control (patch, 2FA, firewall, WAF, secret rotation) for restore.
  4. Remove or disable what is not needed.
  5. Test legitimate access and that the abuse path is blocked.
  6. Confirm what the backup includes (files/DB/mail) for jetbackup, restore, scenario and where the offsite copy lives.
  7. Where possible run a restore test to a safe target before overwriting production.

Verify

  • Result for jetbackup, restore, scenario matches “JetBackup restore-scenario’s”
  • No regression on a critical flow beside jetbackup restore scenarios
  • External test or second browser/network confirms the result

Tip: Work in small steps: get jetbackup, restore, scenario right first, then optional extras.

Note: Do not blindly change production without a backup if jetbackup, restore, scenario touches login, DNS, mail or payments.

Still stuck? Open a ticket with TripleZero iT via the client panel. Include your domain name, what you already tried, and any exact error messages (text or screenshot).

Related: security settings (panel, firewall or CMS), backups, tickets.
